title: Temporal Rift
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Tianming uttered the words 'collect all fragments,' another voice echoed from the depths of the rift—an existence utterly distinct from the Heavenly Celestial Eye, calling out Chen Ji's true name.

text.content:
When the radiance erupting from the Dragon Vein Core tore through the heavens, Chen Ji felt his body being torn apart by an invisible force. The exhaustion from his depleted Heavenly Fate Value made him nearly unable to grasp the Tianji Record Fragment, and that attack capable of destroying an entire state came crushing down with annihilating force.

At this critical moment—on his chest, a jet-black crack suddenly split open.

Not a wound, but space itself tearing apart.

dialogue.content:
"Impossible!" The Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice, transcending time and space, carried astonishment for the first time. "Temporal Rift... How could a mere mortal control such power!"

The crushing attack collided with the rift, sinking like a stone into the sea, not even stirring a single ripple.

text.content:
Chen Ji was dragged into endless darkness by that suction. Wind howled in his ears, and twisted light and shadow filled his vision. He felt himself crossing through something that should not exist in this world—time had lost all meaning here, and space had completely collapsed.

Then, he saw it.

In the deepest part of the rift, a blurry figure was beckoning to him.

dialogue.content:
"Brother... brother..."

The voice was faint as a mosquito's buzz, yet exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's heart. It was Chen Nian! His sister, missing for years and constantly on his mind!

Chen Ji turned sharply, seeing another figure gradually becoming clear on the other side of the rift—an middle-aged man, haggard features, but eyes still sharp as blades.

Chen Tianming. His father.

"Ji'er..." The voice was hoarse and weak, yet carried undeniable resolve, "You've finally arrived."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. His father's form was far worse than he imagined—it was no longer flesh and blood, but a mass of near-transparent light, wrapped around by countless black chains. Those chains extended deep into the edges of the temporal rift, as if using the power of the entire world to imprison him here.

"Father... how are you here?" Chen Ji's voice trembled. "All these years, you..."

Chen Tianming gave a tragic smile: "It's a long story. But now is not the time for reunion."

dialogue.content:
"Brother! Save me!"

Chen Nian's voice came from another direction. Chen Ji turned, seeing his sister wrapped in a mass of blood-colored light, entirely different from the chains binding his father—this was the Demonic Holy Sect's forbidden technique, locking her firmly at the other end of the rift.

Two calls simultaneously tore at Chen Ji's heart.

The Temporal Rift began violently trembling, the exit slowly contracting. He could sense this rift wouldn't last much longer.

text.content:
"You only have a moment." Chen Tianming's voice suddenly turned sharp. "The other end of the rift leads to different time nodes—one side is me ten years ago, when I had not yet been completely sealed; the other is where your sister is right now."

Chen Ji's mind raced rapidly. Temporal Rift... time nodes... this meant he could travel between past and present, but each choice meant abandoning another possibility.

"If you choose to save me—" Chen Tianming's voice suddenly softened, "Be prepared, because the truth I tell you may completely change your understanding of this world."

dialogue.content:
"But if you choose to save your sister—" Chen Tianming's tone shifted. "Her seal comes from the deepest part of the Holy Sect, where secrets are hidden that even surpass the Heavenly Celestial Eye itself. She knows more than anyone."

Chen Nian wailed in the distance: "Brother! Don't worry about me! Save Father first! He's running out of time!"

But Chen Tianming shook his head: "Silly child... She doesn't know what I represent at this time node." He looked at Chen Ji, eyes flashing with complex emotions. "But you should understand—time has its price."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt the remaining Heavenly Fate Value within his body. That previous strike had nearly exhausted all his power; now he only had a final thread remaining—that was the final bond connecting him to the Tianji Record.

If used to save people, this final thread of Heavenly Fate Value would completely dissipate.

If used to escape, he might preserve a chance for a comeback.

But these two people before him... one was the father he had searched for years, the other was the sister he had sworn to protect.

The Temporal Rift let out a piercing roar, the exit collapsing visibly. In another moment, this escape route would vanish completely.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, countless thoughts racing through his mind. He was calculating—not for himself, but for these two most important people in his life.

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind: "Boy, this rift will repair itself automatically... but after repair, it will form a new time loop. Your choice will determine the direction of this loop."

A flicker of understanding flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He understood—this wasn't a simple either-or choice, but a game of timelines.

If he saved his father, he would change the cause and effect of ten years ago, creating an entirely new time branch.

If he saved his sister, he would obtain the secrets of the Holy Sect from her, directly threatening the foundation of the Heavenly Celestial Eye.

But if he chose nothing... the temporal loop would repair automatically, and everything would return to its origin.

This was a third possibility he had never imagined.

"Chen Ji." Chen Tianming suddenly called his name, voice carrying unprecedented solemnity. "Whatever you choose, I am proud of you. In ten years' time, you have reached a height even I never attained."

"But I must tell you one thing—"

A brilliant light suddenly erupted from Chen Tianming's eyes: "The Tianji Record chose you because you carry the purest bloodline of the Chen family. And this secret..."

He suddenly coughed up a mouthful of blood, his form becoming even more ethereal: "The truth of this world is closely connected to the Chen bloodline."

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth and charged toward the time node where his father was. The final thread of Heavenly Fate Value in his body burned like fire, transforming into power to tear open time.

"Father! I've come to save you!"

Chen Tianming gave a tragic smile, but in the next instant, he abruptly waved his hand, striking a beam of light into Chen Ji's brow center: "No... not now. Take this and go! Remember—the fragments of the Tianji Record are scattered across five forbidden lands; only by collecting all fragments can you break the cycle of fate!"

dialogue.content:
"Brother!!!"

Chen Nian's heart-wrenching cry came from behind. Chen Ji felt his heart being torn apart, but his father's voice resounded like a great bell in his mind:

"Go find your sister... she knows where the final fragment lies... the fate of the Chen family, I entrust to you..."

Before the words finished, Chen Tianming's form suddenly exploded into scattered starlight, dragging the chains binding him into the depths of time.

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly turned, charging toward where his sister was. He couldn't watch his sister be imprisoned—that was the person he had sworn to protect since the first day he transmigrated to this world.

"Chen Nian! Grab my hand!"

He seized his sister's ice-cold fingers; the final Heavenly Fate Value in his body transformed into scorching golden light, frantically burning away that blood-colored seal.

dialogue.content:
The seal let out a piercing shriek, melting rapidly like snow under the scorching sun. Chen Nian threw herself into Chen Ji's embrace, her frail form trembling violently.

"Brother... it really is you..." Her voice carried a sob, "I thought I'd never see you again..."

Chen Ji held her tightly, but his heart was being cut like a blade. Because behind him, his father's light was dissipating, and that voice was growing more distant:

"Go... find all the fragments... break this damn fate..."

text.content:
"On Chen Ji's chessboard, the words 'give up' have never existed!"

Chen Ji abruptly thrust both palms forward, his left hand grabbing toward his father, his right toward his sister. The Tianji Record Fragment at this moment erupted with unprecedented light—that was power exchanged for the essence of life itself.

Temporal rifts exploded around him; countless shards of time spun wildly. Agonizing pain came from every limb and fiber, as if the entire world was tearing him apart.

dialogue.content:
"You madman!" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare terror, "You'll die doing this!"

But Chen Ji laughed. It was an almost insane laugh.

"If I can't even protect my family, what's the point of this life!"

In the next instant, his left hand finally touched his father's light, his right hand tightly grasped his sister's hand.

Time and space let out a mournful cry—two timelines were actually being forcibly twisted together by him!

text.content:
In the temporal chaos, Chen Ji felt his consciousness being torn apart. Countless images flashed before his eyes—the past, the present, the future, all tangled together.

He saw the fall of Tianqing Sect, the conspiracy of the Demonic Holy Sect, the Heavenly Celestial Eye's true form...

And a truth he had never imagined.

The Chen family... was actually the original creator of the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content:
When consciousness returned, Chen Ji found himself lying in ruins. His meridians were completely shattered, Heavenly Fate Value nearly depleted, but the two hands he tightly grasped gave him endless strength.

On his left was Chen Nian; on his right was... a mass of faint light.

From within that light, Chen Tianming's voice drifted like a wisp of silk:

"Well done... my son..."

"Remember... the Tianji Record... scattered across five forbidden lands... when gathered... that will be the time to break fate..."

The light slowly faded, but Chen Tianming's form had become one degree more solid than before.

text.content:
Chen Nian leaned tightly against Chen Ji, tears blurring her eyes: "Brother... Father he..."

Chen Ji gently patted her back; his voice, though weak, carried undeniable resolve: "He's still alive. As long as we gather all fragments of the Tianji Record, we can completely rescue him."

He raised his head toward the shattered sky; the Heavenly Celestial Eye's pressure had dissipated, but that feeling of being watched had never been more intense.

"Five forbidden lands..." he murmured, eyes flashing with determination. "Chen Ji's chess game has only just begun."

At this moment, Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. A new stream of information flooded his mind—that was an explanation of his newly awakened temporal ability.

【Temporal Rift · Initial Stage】
Effect: Can automatically open an escape channel in critical moments
Cost: Consumes all remaining Heavenly Fate Value
Advancement Condition: Collect Tianji Record Fragments

Chen Ji gave a bitter laugh. This ability... truly was born for escape.

But at least, he survived. With his father's fragmentary soul, with his sister, with the ultimate secrets of this world—and survival itself is the greatest victory.

Chen Nian suddenly spoke up: "Brother, I know the location of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. Inside... there is the third fragment of the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji looked at her sharply.

Chen Nian's eyes flickered with complex light: "All these years... they thought I was a prisoner, but they didn't know I had been observing in secret. What the Holy Sect hides in its depths is more terrifying than anyone imagines."

She gripped Chen Ji's hand tightly: "But as long as I'm with Brother, I'm not afraid of anything."

Chen Ji's heart warmed, but the corner of his mouth curved into a dangerous arc. The Holy Sect...，正好，旧账新仇一起算。

From the distance, the direction of Tianqing Sect echoed with earth-shaking roars. The sect competition was underway, and Chen Ji... finally didn't have to fight alone.

He had a sister to fight alongside, a father waiting to be rescued, a shocking secret about the Chen bloodline, and a temporal ability that, though depleted, could advance at any moment.

Most importantly—he had a completely new understanding of the Heavenly Celestial Eye's布局.

That game of chess, he had decided to play.

Just then, an aged voice came from the depths of the ruins: "Hehe... Chen family boy, you are more resourceful than I anticipated."

Chen Ji turned sharply, seeing an unexpected figure emerging from the shadows—it was actually... Ling Yuan?

Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Chen Tianming's former fellow junior, was now regarding Chen Ji and Chen Nian beside him with complex eyes.

"You think you're opposing Heaven?" The old man snorted dismissively. "You're merely crashing around on the chessboard it has drawn."

Chen Ji slowly stood up; despite being covered in wounds, his gaze was calm as an abyss: "So what? As long as the pieces awaken, the chessboard will eventually be overturned."

A flicker of appreciation flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes: "Interesting... it seems your father was not mistaken about you."

He turned and walked toward the distance: "In three months, the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds will open. Perhaps... we will have an opportunity to cooperate."

As the words fell, the old man's figure vanished into the void.

Chen Nian vigilantly watched the direction where Ling Yuan disappeared: "Brother, this person cannot be trusted. He was Father's old enemy; back then, it was precisely because he coveted the Tianji Record that..."

Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her, a meaningful smile curling at his lips: "I know. But sometimes, enemies are more valuable than friends."

He raised his head toward the horizon, his eyes reflecting the countless stars in the sky.

Father said to break fate, one must collect all fragments.

Then... let's begin collecting.

Starting from the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds, starting from the secret Chen Nian spoke of.
